native_qualification.clippy_scope: --locked --workspace --all-targets --features borsuk/s3-vectors-bench -- -D clippy::correctness -D clippy::suspicious; other warnings remain.
native_qualification.commands_record: run.sh; each stage has a .log and .exit file; terminal.json binds source and test counts.
native_qualification.testbuild_command: env -u BORSUK_TEST_BUILD_COMMAND BORSUK_TEST_BUILD_JOBS=4 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 bash scripts/check_rust_test_build.sh
native_qualification.verification_method: Read retained script, stage exits, test summaries, terminal receipt and original SSM result; no rerun.

release_binary.note: The publication packet includes its hash receipt, not the ELF itself.
